events.title: Simplified Chinese and NEW HERO just arrived!
events.summary: Arrr, ye salty fishermen! Steam Next Fest be upon us, and we got a couple o’ fine surprises for ye scurvy lot! New hero on the horizon — the mighty pirate Eliza! With this fierce lass sailin’ alongside ye, all orange trinkets have their effects DOUBLED! Strong as a kraken’s grip, ain’t she? But every treasure has its curse…Eliza gets 1 less bait each day (save for the very first), and she hauls in 1 fewer item than our first hero. Keen to test this sea dog out? events.title: Open Playtest is LIVE!
events.summary: Hey everyone, After a lot of grinding, we're super excited to finally announce that the Brofish Playtest is now live! Brofish is our love letter to autobattlers and roguelites, a hybrid where you fish for bizarre creatures, build powerful teams, and defend your village from waves of undead in a mix of auto-battler + tower defense gameplay.
